preflight.result: BLOCKED: no PayPal sandbox credentials found

transaction.reason: No existing sandbox app client id/secret or test-buyer credentials are available; no new sandbox account was created.

conclusion: Simulated mode is caused only by missing server credentials, not by PAYPAL_FORCE_SIMULATED. The sandbox REST host is reachable but every authenticated call is blocked without the existing app/buyer credentials. The app must stay labelled simulated until a real sandbox authorization/capture or void succeeds.
